## Infinite Shock/Crush Status Cycler

Allows you to cycle your kart status between infinite shock and infinite crush, without damage or item drop. You can also cycle back to the normal kart status.

Press the cycle button to set infinite shock. Press the button again to clear shock and set infinite crush. Press the button again to clear crush and kart is now back to normal. Press button again to repeat this cycle.

NOTE: They're not really "infinite", they end after 9 minutes. Just cycle again to re-set it.

This code is useful for practicing shortcuts while you're shocked or crushed, test if certain ramps or parts of a Custom Track can be completed in these states or just for fun!

Cycle buttons for each controller:
* Wii Wheel / Nunchuk: B + Minus
* Classic Controller: ZL + Minus
* GameCube Controller: Y + R

The code works for each individual player in Multiplayer
